title: Idea feed response
description: Contract for one synthesis run. Written for OpenAI strict structured outputs: every property is required and optionality is expressed as a nullable type union, because strict mode does not honour partial 'required' lists.

title.description: Publishable headline. Not a topic label.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what happened and why it matters.

angle.description: The specific take to write from, not a restatement of the summary.

interests.description: Which of the author's interests this matches.

format.description: Suggested treatment. 'either' when the material genuinely supports both.

points.description: Three to six points the piece should cover.

sources.description: The candidate items this idea was drawn from. Empty only if the idea is not traceable to one.

confidence.description: 0-1. How strongly this is worth writing. Used for ranking, so spread the range.
